lore.reliable_requiem.crystal_shard: A glittering sliver of crystallised life. Turns up in broken Monster Spawners and the monsters they summon, cracked geodes, old ruins, Piglin trades and the occasional lucky catch.
lore.reliable_requiem.crystal_heart: A crystallised heart. Use it to permanently raise your maximum health by one heart.
lore.reliable_requiem.crystal_bolt: A crackling crystal. Use it to permanently raise your maximum stamina by one bolt.
